# Third-party notices

## Embedded Pokemon sprites

Pixy includes ANSI Pokemon sprites sourced from
[krabby](https://github.com/yannjor/krabby), which is distributed under
GPL-3.0. Krabby generated the terminal artwork from
[PokéSprite](https://github.com/msikma/pokesprite) using
[pokemon-generator-scripts](https://gitlab.com/phoneybadger/pokemon-generator-scripts),
with data from [PokéAPI](https://github.com/PokeAPI/pokeapi).

The GPL-3.0 text is included at `LICENSES/GPL-3.0-only.txt`.

PokéSprite states that the sprite images are © Nintendo/Creatures Inc./GAME
FREAK Inc. Pokémon and related names are trademarks of their respective
owners. Pixy is not affiliated with or endorsed by those owners.
